NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    - Target daily deficit: 300-500 kcal below maintenance
    - Calculate maintenance using Mifflin-St Jeor equation
    - Adjust calories every 4 weeks based on progress
  MACROS:
    - Protein: 1.6-2.0g/kg bodyweight per day
    - Carbohydrate: 40-45% of total calories, focus on low glycaemic index sources (e.g. oats, quinoa, lentils, beans, sweet potato, non-starchy vegetables)
    - Fat: 25-30% of total calories, focus on unsaturated fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, fatty fish)
  MEAL STRUCTURE:
    - 3 main meals + 1-2 snacks per day
    - Distribute carbohydrates evenly across meals to avoid large postprandial glucose spikes
    - Include protein and fibre at every meal
    - Avoid skipping meals
    - Hydration: minimum 2L water per day
  DIABETES-SPECIFIC GUIDELINES:
    - Avoid added sugars and refined carbohydrates
    - Prioritise high-fibre foods (vegetables, legumes, whole grains)
    - Monitor blood glucose before and after exercise, especially if training intensity increases
    - Carry a fast-acting carbohydrate (e.g. glucose tablets) during workouts in case of hypoglycaemia
    - Limit alcohol; if consumed, always with food
    - Consult with healthcare provider before making significant dietary changes
  SUPPLEMENTS:
    - Consider vitamin D and omega-3 if intake is low
    - No supplements to replace prescribed medication
  NOTES:
    - Review nutrition and training progress every 4 weeks
    - Adjust plan based on weight, glucose trends, and feedback
    - Encourage regular sleep (7-8h/night) and stress management
